item.title: Duke files a lawsuit against QB Darian Mensah to enforce his contract and block a transfer
item.description: Duke has filed a lawsuit against quarterback Darian Mensah seeking to block his efforts to transfer and reach a contract with another school to play elsewhere next season.

item.title: Wrightsville Beach issues violation notice to Commodore Club over public access dispute
item.description: A private social club and restaurant at Wrightsville Beach is making waves with some town leaders.

item.title: Pender County questions Burgaw’s claim for full amount of occupancy tax
item.description: Tourism dollars generate lots of monies for counties and with tourism growing in Pender County, the town of Burgaw wants to keep all of the funds their occupancy taxes generate.

item.title: The Eagle’s Dare bar owner faces violation for cargo container
item.description: Joseph Apkarian is the owner of, "The Eagle's Dare," on 3rd street downtown is facing a violation from the City of Wilmington due to a cargo container that sits on the property.

item.title: Ashley hires Adam Purzitza as head football coach
item.description: Another Carolina Coast Conference head football coaching position has been filled as Ashley has named Adam Purzitza to the role.

item.title: NHC Commissioners name January 20th as National Day of Racial Healing
item.description: One of the first items that was on the agenda was a proclamation from the County's Commission on African American History, Heritage, and Culture, recognizing the Tuesday following MLK Day as a National Day of Racial Healing.

item.title: Carlos Beltrán and Andruw Jones elected to baseball’s Hall of Fame
item.description: Carlos Beltrán fielded a question about the impact of his role in the Houston Astros' cheating scandal as deftly as he grabbed so many balls hit to him in center field.

item.title: Columbus County Commissioners approve additional funding for EMS vehicles
item.description: Commissioners approved a budget amendment of more than $420,000, which will allow the continued use of two quick response vehicles, or QRV.

item.title: New Hanover bounces back to beat Laney 72-62
item.description: Despite suffering their first conference loss in five years during their last game, New Hanover boys basketball bounced back to knock off Laney on the road 72-62 on Tuesday.

item.title: Hoggard takes down North Brunswick 69-43
item.description: What was a matchup between teams tied in the Carolina Coast standings ended up being a home win for Hoggard as they took down North Brunswick on Tuesday 69-43.
